critical_code_review_comments: Mobile app restructure is solid: per-tab Stack pattern correctly isolates inner-screen navigation (fixes the Bhakti inner-link bug). SafeAreaProvider at root + SafeScreen wrapper on every leaf screen is a clean pattern.
Granth/Vedas screens correctly call live admin DB endpoints — no stale mockData fallback for these flows (only Kathas remain embedded which is intentional per request).
GranthVersesScreen handles both meaning.hi and display_meaning shapes (defensive parsing) — good resilience against schema variance.
Hanuman Chalisa stored inline in mockData.js (~2.3KB) is fine for now; eventually migrate to admin DB for editorial control.
Carry-over: backend server.py still >5000 lines (noted in iter6/7) — not in scope for this review.

rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration. Initial test assertion mismatch (expected 'ramayan' substring) was a test-side issue, not a product issue; corrected to accept 'ramcharitmanas'.
